title: Ripple Carry Adder
statement: Implement an 8-bit ripple carry adder with carry-in and carry-out. The module must compute the full sum of two operands plus the carry-in, producing the lower 8 bits and a carry-out. This is the classic serialized carry-chain adder used in basic ALU datapaths.
module_signature: module ripple_carry_adder(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input cin, output [7:0] sum, output cout);
behavior: cout is the carry-out of the addition.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use the + operator for the entire 8-bit vector if you want a structural solution.
hint: Build the adder from full-adders or use vector addition directly with carry.
